stance_basis: cited as a data source reporting findings on plastics incineration without expressing support or opposition to the project
summary: The Society of the Plastics Industries, Inc. is cited once in the document as a source reporting that burning 2 to 4 percent plastics with other refuse in incinerators does not damage the incinerators or significantly alter effluent gas composition. The agency notes the preliminary nature of the SPI study and neither endorses nor refutes its findings. The entity takes no position on the proposed action itself; it is referenced purely as an industry data source.
